# Countryfile.com

> Your guide to Britain's countryside, wildlife, walks, and traditional country living through expert guides, BBC television content, and seasonal adventures.

Countryfile.com is the digital home of the BBC's long-running Countryfile brand, offering comprehensive resources for outdoor enthusiasts, wildlife watchers, and countryside lovers. The site combines practical how-to guides, species identification resources, curated walking trails, travel features, and content from the BBC Countryfile Magazine and TV show.

## Key Topics

- British wildlife
- UK walking trails
- Countryside lifestyle
- Species identification
- Outdoor activities
- Nature conservation
- Invasive species
- UK travel guides
- Foraging and traditional recipes
- BBC Countryfile TV show
- King Charles III England Coast Path
- Seasonal guides
- Birdwatching
- Rural heritage

## Core Destinations

- [Countryfile.com: walks, wildlife, foraging and traditional recipes](https://www.countryfile.com): Homepage showcasing Britain's walks, wildlife, foraging, recipes and countryside lifestyle
- [Go Outdoors | Countryfile.com](https://www.countryfile.com/go-outdoors): Main outdoor activities section featuring walks, trails and UK adventures
- [Wildlife | Countryfile.com](https://www.countryfile.com/wildlife): Wildlife hub for species identification, news and British animal spotting
- [Animals | Countryfile.com](https://www.countryfile.com/animals): Animals section covering pets, farm animals and wildlife behavior
- [People | Countryfile.com](https://www.countryfile.com/people): People section with historical figures and cultural heritage profiles

## Guides & How-To

- [How to | Countryfile.com](https://www.countryfile.com/how-to): Guides for outdoor skills, country crafts and seasonal recipes

- [Divine spring walks: 23 of the best UK trails to enjoy right now | Countryfile.com](https://www.countryfile.com/go-outdoors/walks/britains-best-spring-walks): Guide to 23 best spring walking trails across the UK
